treatment_summary.value: Levothyroxine 25 mcg daily for central hypothyroidism (started at about 7 months); stopped for 6 weeks at age 3 years for a TRH stimulation test, then resumed. Physical therapy, occupational therapy and speech therapy. No vigabatrin reported for this patient.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: High urinary excretion of GHB (urine organic acids by GC‐MS), elevated serum GHB and GABA, MR spectroscopy showing GABA accumulation in the right globus pallidus, and a novel homozygous ALDH5A1 variant on whole‐exome sequencing

parental_testing_statement.value: Both parents were heterozygous carriers for this variant.

functional_evidence_statement.value: No in vitro studies performed. Elevated urine and serum GABA and GHB and MRS GABA peaks were considered functional validation; in silico programs (SIFT, PolyPhen2, AlignGVD, MutationTaster) predicted pathogenicity; structural modelling: Leu70 lies in a surface loop >15 Å from the active site and substitution by proline is predicted to destabilize the structure locally.

pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors.value: variant of uncertain significance (VUS) (class 3) per ACMG; authors argue the biochemical and MRI findings favour pathogenicity
